review: Reviewed AccountSessionPanel changed hunks, surrounding account reads/mutations and presentation, both complete account suites, compact catalog metadata and the unchanged catalog integrity suite.

The installed panel presents shared Auth0 sign-in before a separate password profile, shows provider email verification without local password verification, makes local hosted entry feature/lock scoped, and treats unfinished launch visibility separately from room authority.

Account refreshes use a generation guard after each asynchronous stage. Explicit mutation/manual refresh supersedes an older read; background ancillary reads no longer retain the account read lock. Session replacement clears old ancillary projections, unmount invalidates observations, and signed-out archive lookup has no default profile.

Confirmed sign-out and profile deletion clear the visible account, prior ancillary observations and displayed credential drafts before a follow-up read. A failed follow-up read cannot leave the old profile visible. This does not cancel an issued mutation or claim complete mutation lifecycle isolation.

Three new regressions cover blocked ancillary reads during sign-out, superseded account responses, and failed follow-up status reads. Existing loading test now starts a second refresh after initial account resolution, preserving its intended check that refresh does not disable account actions.

Catalog metadata now agrees with actual current keys: 5813 source/English, 5796 German and Arabic; all other counts remain unchanged. Existing integrity tests verify all counts, placeholders and source membership. Catalog contents remain separate review inputs.
limits: Private unfrozen source proposal; no publication or real account action.
Twenty-eight mocked tests across three suites qualify the selected UI and catalog integrity, not native Auth0, credentials, local hosted funding or installed account replacement.

The refresh generation covers observations, not every outstanding account mutation. Ingress/token/reset/export callback isolation and external account event lifecycle remain separate acceptance concerns.
Captain Keyes task access, account policy, source catalog and other omitted dependencies retain separate review status. Local-hosted, brokerage and Google components are mocked in some suites.
InstalledServicesPanel and AgentAccessPanel remain under review. Existing support contact remains in the final owner publication review.
